data.title: Web version links to the GitHub repo from the masthead

data.body: Implemented by orchestrator: 'source' anchor (existing .download styling) before the desktop link in the masthead; shows everywhere including Tauri, per plan. tsc+build clean.

Reviewed commit ee4c374 cold against plan. Verified: 'source' anchor placed before the desktop link and OUTSIDE the __TAURI_INTERNALS__ conditional (renders in both web and Tauri); 'desktop ↓' remains web-only inside the conditional; href https://github.com/malls/pattern-maker, target _blank, rel noopener, reuses .download class (10px mono, label gray, hover ink, orange focus-visible ring — brand styling untouched, no CSS change needed). Masthead layout accommodates the second link: .masthead is flex/baseline with 10px gap and .tagline margin-left:auto still pushes tagline+links+power right. Only src/main.ts changed in source (remaining diff is .lattice tracking metadata). npx tsc --noEmit clean; npm run build clean (35 modules, 145ms). No findings. Verdict: pass, meets all acceptance criteria.
